text:
nina: ok quick poll — who is leaving those tiny comic strips on the east whiteboard by the 4th-floor couches? :eyes:
omar: WAIT which comics?? I thought those were cafeteria menu drafts 😂
kevin: the ones with the tiny shark wearing a tie. saw 3 new panels this morning.
mia: i peak every morning now, it s a part of my routine ngl. :coffee:
devon: i nominate 'The Midnight Illustrator' as official nickname. we need merch.
nana: maybe put a sticky that says 'signed: midnight artist' and see if they claim fame? :thinking_face:
kevin: pls no, they'll go full noir and make a dramatic escape scene.
nina: i left a tiny thank-you note in the marker tray signed "—a fan". we will see if they reply in comics.
omar: @kitchen-bot did you happen to capture the whiteboard cam last night? (no judgement)
kitchen-bot: camera-snapshot uploaded: https://img.redwood.local/4f/board-1769000000.jpg (access: eng-team) :camera:
mia: omg the jagged speech bubble at the top. 100% intentional.
devon: theory: it s someone from eng-infra who is testing marker-resistant coatings but also very dramatic.
kevin: theory 2: it s someone from design doing guerrilla micro-comics to boost morale.
nana: proposal: find the artist, offer them a tiny stipend (one sticker pack + donut) and name the next meeting room after them.
nina: i like the donut idea. if they want anonymity, we'll just call the room 'The Cove' and hang the comics there.
omar: vote: sticker+donut? :thumbsup: / no donut? :thumbsdown:
kevin: :thumbsup:
mia: :thumbsup: :donut:
devon: :thumbsup: very important cultural contribution.
nana: also suggest we formalize a 'whiteboard appreciation hour' every friday 10:30am.
kitchen-bot: scheduled: whiteboard-appreciation every Friday 10:30 AM in #random (recurring) :spiral_calendar:
kevin: lovely. also — can someone archive the comics before they get rubbed out by the janitor? archiver bot?
nina: i'll snap pics tomorrow am and drop them in the culture drive.
omar: if the artist is reading: we will protect your identity and offer unlimited supply of dry-erase markers. :art: :seal_of_approval:
nana: signed, the committee for tiny things that make our day
kevin: committee meeting adjourned.
nana: :sparkles:
